subject: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & token volumes (follow-up)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-14T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: unit economics & next steps

Thanks again for the call today, Alice — really helpful to get context on FintechX's roadmap. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned: 

Summary from today's discovery:
- Core integration: conversational customer support + automated KYC assist (two features).
- Initial target: pilot in Q3 with 50M-100M tokens/month across both features; potential to scale to 300M+ in 12 months if engagement holds.
- Primary success metrics: cost per feature, margin delta vs current human process, and CAC payback within 6-9 months.

Open clarifications we need from you (please confirm):
1) Can you confirm the 50M-100M tokens/month expected for the pilot (range ok)?
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly) for the pilot — ballpark is fine (e.g., $5k-10k/month).
3) Any hard $/1M tokens target we should aim for when sizing proposals?

Proposed next steps:
- Alice: share the token projection workbook you mentioned (monthly volumes by feature).
- Redwood: we'll send a one-page unit-econ template and a ballpark pricing range for $/1M tokens and suggested model configs (gpt-like open model variants).
- Schedule a 60-min deep-dive next week to walk unit economics with Rishi (solutions) and Aditya (AE) — does Tue/Wed look good?

Attachments: none on my side — will follow with the unit-econ template.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@fintechx.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: unit economics & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and attaching the projection workbook we discussed.

Answers to open items:
1) Pilot volumes: yes — 50M-100M tokens/month is the right initial expectation (50M conservative, 100M if adoption is strong). We expect ~60% of tokens from conversational support and ~40% from KYC assist.
2) Budget: leadership has allocated a pilot budget in the range of $10k-30k/month for inference (they were expecting mid-teens $/1M tokens once optimized).
3) Hard target: ideally we want to be at or under $100/1M tokens for pilot, with long-term goal $40-60/1M as we optimize/model-swap.

I've attached "fintechx_token_projection.xlsx" (monthly breakdown by feature and expected growth scenarios).

We're interested in seeing Redwood's unit-econ template and a quick ballpark for $/1M tokens across small/medium/large model configs. Also we'd like a short note on expected margin impact per feature (e.g., expected cost vs current manual cost per ticket).

Availability: Tue 6/23 or Wed 6/24 afternoons PST look good for a deep-dive.

Cheers,
Alice Johnson
VP Product, FintechX
alice.johnson@fintechx.com
--- Attachment: fintechx_token_projection.xlsx (Excel workbook, 1 sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@fintechx.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: unit economics & next steps

Thanks Alice — got the workbook. Sending our unit-econ template and a short, high-level ballpark for $/1M tokens below so you can share with leadership ahead of the deep-dive.

Attached: "redwood_unit_econ_template.xlsx" (fills in assumptions below).

High-level ballpark pricing (per 1M tokens, inference-only cost to customer) — conservative list for pilot scoping: 
- Small model (quantized 7B class): $30-50 / 1M tokens
- Medium model (13B optimized): $60-90 / 1M tokens
- Large model (70B / near-LLM): $180-260 / 1M tokens

Notes on ranges: exact $/1M depends on effective batching rates, KV cache hit % for conversational UX, and session length distribution. We assume standard caching and 4-8 token batching for pilot estimates.

Unit economics template highlights (see attachment for downloadable sheet):
- Inputs: token volumes by feature, average tokens per session, conversion/engagement lift assumptions, average revenue per successful conversion, current human cost per handled session.
- Outputs: incremental gross margin per feature, CAC payback months (given your marketing CAC), and suggested target $/feature to preserve margin targets.

Quick example (sample numbers):
- Feature A (auto KYC assist): 25M tokens/mo, inference cost at $60/1M => $1,500/mo inference. Current human cost equivalent: $12,000/mo => projected gross margin uplift ~ $10.5k/mo.
- Feature B (conversational support): 75M tokens/mo, inference cost at $60/1M => $4,500/mo. Current staffing cost: $30k/mo => uplift ~ $25.5k/mo.
- Combined pilot (100M tokens): inference ~= $6,000/mo at $60/1M; aggregated margin delta supports positive CAC payback in ~4-8 months depending on marketing spend.

Ask for deep-dive: please confirm which scenarios in the spreadsheet you want us to prioritize (conservative / base / aggressive), and whether finance wants a per-feature $/feature target or a consolidated target for product.

Proposed deep-dive times: Tue 2026-06-23 2:00pm PST or Wed 2026-06-24 3:00pm PST — Rishi and Aditya will run the model sizing and walk the numbers. Which works for you?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
--- Attachment: redwood_unit_econ_template.xlsx (Excel workbook, with example inputs)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: FintechX unit-econ prep (prior to Tue deep-dive)

Internal notes / ask before the call with FintechX: 

1) Run three scenario cost estimates for the attached FintechX workbook (conservative/base/aggressive) using the following model configs: quantized-7B, optimized-13B, and 70B (4-bit / batch-optimized). Output should be: monthly inference $ at customer-facing $/1M bands and our internal run-rate cost estimate.
2) For each scenario, compute: $/feature (inference cost per feature per month), projected gross margin uplift vs current human cost (they provided rough staffing figures on call), and CAC payback months assuming marketing CAC = $1,200 and expected monthly net new MRR from pilot = $3,000 (use placeholders but flag as assumptions).
3) Prepare a 1-slide summary and a 1-page appendix with the model assumptions for the call.

Timing: need draft numbers by Mon EOD 6/22 so we can sanity-check before Tue's call.

Thanks — I'll lead the walkthrough.
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
